summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Funding Cut
items.text: Saudi Arabia’s PIF will fund LIV Golf only through 2026 while the Asian Tour deepens ties with PGA and DP World Tours, threatening LIV's future.

items.headline: McIlroy Critiques PGA Playoffs
items.text: Rory McIlroy said he leads’t play the PGA Tour 'for a while,' criticizing the FedExCup playoffs format for reducing incentive to compete early.
